none: PAS NLM-B897E3: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

: Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: (---)CLAVDIVS AVG. Revere description: Figure standing right, possibly with transverse spear or sceptre and, more definitely, a feature resembling a downward pointing priapus, two upright bars in right field - possibly scales - and the letter A in left field.…
